name: Homer (United States)
description: Orange field charged at the centre with the city seal of Homer between two white halibut, the seal showing a ship's wheel over a mountain and dated MARCH 31, 1964, the date of incorporation.
history: Homer is a city in Kenai Peninsula Borough, Alaska, 218 miles southwest of Anchorage. Flags of the World records that the city council settled the colours in late August 1984; the seal bears the date of incorporation, 31 March 1964.

features.role: city seal between two white halibut
